root_cause.summary: The previous session erroneously treated costume TID 30049 as Eunhwa's default base costume, resolving to c095 (the base military uniform). Furthermore, card_builder.py prioritized roster.costume_id over detail.costume_tid/id, which would prevent detail skin IDs from being honored.
root_cause.correction: Costume TID 30049 is the official alternate skin 'Day Off' (度假 / 休息日), corresponding to independent Spine 4.1 asset c095_01. Default appearance in Nikke is costume ID 0 (or None/'0'/'default') mapping to c095. An equipped skin must NEVER fall back to default clothing.

solution.costume_selection: Added resolve_equipped_costume() with priority detail.costume_tid > detail.costume_id > roster.costume_tid > roster.costume_id.
solution.character_master: Removed all false default_costume_id entries from character_master.json, ensuring 30049 is not classified as default.
solution.costumes_registry: Added verified entry 30049 -> c095_01 in assets/costumes.json with sha256 and source metadata.
solution.spine_manifest: Added c095_01 entry to spine-manifest.json with verified dimensions (398x892) and sha256 c8d03a30747d63acf9eab8607cec1fee68a6b176f7780a4c885d1cc7d676981d.

card_output.portrait_description: White sundress, straw bag with strawberry, strawberry drink ('Day Off')
